Services
The Assessor covers 436 sq. miles of Andrew County and places value on assessed personal and real property. (We also sell wall plat maps, aerial maps and topographical maps.)
New residents need to be assessed immediately!
Personal property tax is based off of January 1st of the year.
Personal Property Assessment sheets are mailed to tax payers the first week of January.
It is the tax payers responsibility to notify the Assessor’s Office of address changes.
It is the tax payers responsibility to notify the assessor’s office if no assessment sheet is received in the mail. Contact our office for details.
Link of Interest: State Tax Commission of Missouri
The agency charged with overseeing Missouri’s property assessment system, and assisting county assessors. Please, take a few minutes to learn about the State Tax Commission, how your property is assessed, and the appeal process.
